name: agents
description: Python (FastAPI) AI agents service. These scripts only wrap uv so Turborepo runs it with the rest of the monorepo.

scripts.start: uv run --env-file .env opentelemetry-instrument fastapi run src/agents_service/main.py --port ${AGENTS_PORT:-8000}
scripts.start:worker: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=agents-worker uv run --env-file .env opentelemetry-instrument arq agents_service.worker.WorkerSettings
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
